verses.1: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ.
verses.2: As it is written in the Book of Isaiah: “I will send my messenger before you, who will prepare your way.”
verses.3: The voice of the warrior in the desert; prepare the path for the Lord, and carry out His commands promptly.
verses.4: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching baptism for the forgiveness of sins.
verses.5: And all of Judea, along with all the people of Jerusalem, went to him. They baptized themselves in the river Jordan, admitting their sins before him.
verses.6: And John was wearing a crown of feathers, along with a belt made of leather around his waist. He also wore earrings and wild honey as decorations.
verses.7: And he proclaimed, “My stronger opponent is coming back to me. I am not worthy of holding the reins of his subordinates.”
verses.8: I have baptized you with water; he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.
verses.9: And on those days, Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and baptized in the Jordan by John.
verses.10: And as he continued to climb up from the water, he saw that the heavens were covered, and the wind seemed to be blowing towards him like a whirlwind.
verses.11: And a voice came from heaven: “You are my beloved Son; in you I have glorified myself.”
verses.12: And immediately, the spirit drove him into the desert.
verses.13: And he spent forty days in the wilderness, being tempted by Satan. He also lived among wild animals, and the angels continued to visit him.
verses.14: And after Jesus was delivered, He went to Galilee, proclaiming the gospel of God.
verses.15: And saying that time will come when the kingdom of God will be completed, let us also repent and believe in the gospel.
verses.16: And as Simon stood by the sea of Galilee, he saw his brother Andrew also standing there in the sea. They were both fishermen.
verses.17: And Jesus said to them, “Come back to me, and I will make you become fishermen of men.”
verses.18: And immediately after they destroyed the networks, they followed him.
verses.19: And he saw little of Jacob, the son of Zebedaeus, and also his brother John. He saw them as they were setting up the networks on the ship.
verses.20: And immediately, he called them forward. After killing their father Zebedaeus, they left the ship along with the hired workers and returned to him.
verses.21: They also went to Kafarnaum. And immediately, during the Sabbaths, he taught them how to gather together.
verses.22: And they were surprised by his teachings, for he was teaching them that he had authority, and not just like those officials who had no real power at all.
verses.23: And soon, there was a man among them who was filled with impure spirit, and he became violent.
verses.24: “What is it for us and for you, Jesus Nazarene? Have you come to save us? Do you know who you are, O holy one of God?”
verses.25: And Jesus said to him, “Be quiet, and leave him alone.”
verses.26: And they scattered his unclean breath from him. Then a loud noise came from him.
verses.27: And they all gathered together, so that they could discuss among themselves, “What is this? Please teach us something new. In accordance with your authority, you can give instructions to those who are imperfect in their spirit. And they will obey you.”
verses.28: And his voice spread throughout all the regions of Galilee at once.
verses.29: And immediately after leaving the gathering, they went to Simon’s house, along with Jacob and John.
verses.30: And Simon’s grieving wife was in a state of despair. Immediately, they told her about her situation.
verses.31: And when he came close to her, he held her hand. Then, the fever left her, and she was able to walk again.
verses.32: When the blindness occurred, and the sun was visible, they brought all those who were ill-treated and those who were possessed to him.
verses.33: And the entire city was arranged around the entrance.
verses.34: And he cured many people who suffered from various diseases. He also drove away many demons. He never spoke against those demons, because they knew him well.
verses.35: And early in the morning, many people rushed out and went to a desert place where they were still staying.
verses.36: And Simon and those who were with him also chased after him.
verses.37: And they also find him and say to him that everyone is looking for him.
verses.38: And he said to them, “Let us go into the theaters that have been prepared for this purpose. For that is where I will proclaim my message.” This is why we came here.
verses.39: And he went and preached to their assemblies throughout all Galilee, driving out the demons.
verses.40: And a sick man comes to him, begging for his help. He also says to him, “If you want, I can cleanse you.”
verses.41: And, angry, he stretched out his hand and said to him, “I want you to be purified.”
verses.42: And soon after, the leprosy left him, and he became clean again.
verses.43: And when he touched him, he immediately cast him out.
verses.44: And he said to him, “Do not say anything at all. Instead, bring yourself before the priest and follow the instructions given by Moses regarding your purification.”
verses.45: But the man who left began to spread his message everywhere, so that it became impossible for him to enter the city openly. Instead, he went to places in the countryside. People came to him from all directions.
